title: Knowledge service (OKS)
description: Turns the knowledge service and data file declared by the session's workspace into five native tools (search / references / info / check_intent / query): find a key by name or description, walk the reference graph backwards from a key, read a node by key, validate a business question into structured intents, then answer it with real rows over a read-only connection. No model is baked in — a workspace opts in with an oks.json, and the agent explores the domain starting from the opaque key "index". The plugin writes nothing into the workspace.
